description.value:
Your body builds primal energy that you can unleash to disable technology. Attempt a @Check[nature|against:fortitude] check against all glitching creatures, hazards, and items with the tech trait within 20 feet. The DC is equal to the creature or hazard's Fortitude DC or the Fortitude DC of the creature attending the object, or is based on the item's level if it's unattended. Regardless of the results, each target is then temporarily immune to Amplify Glitch for 1 day.

Critical Success Increase target's glitching condition value by 4.

Success Increase target's glitching condition value by 2.
